family_definition.wall: W_n is an elementary (n x n)-wall with bipartition A_n,B_n; every wall edge e=ab receives one subdivision/component vertex z_e.
family_definition.vertices: A_n union B_n union Z_n union constant_vertices
edges: s1 is complete to A_n union B_n
r is complete to A_n union B_n
for each original wall edge e=ab, z_e-a and z_e-b
for one fixed wall edge e*=a*b*, additionally r-z_{e*}

extension.proof: Every declared edge joins different assigned colors: support/selection gadget is proper; A-B edges are 2-3; r-wall edges are 4-(2/3); ordinary z_e sees only colors 2,3 and receives 4; special z* sees 2,3,4 and receives 1.

axioms.i: PASS: G is connected; seed connects the constant gadget, every wall survivor sees s1, every z_e sees wall endpoints, w sees a1,a2, and m sees p,n0,r.
axioms.ii: PASS: S induces edge s1-s2; no outside vertex is adjacent to both s1 and s2.
axioms.iii: PASS: exactly m,w,Z_n are anticomplete to S and hence form Y0.
axioms.iv: PASS VACUOUS: G[Y0] is stable, so there is no Y0 edge on which an outside vertex could be mixed.
axioms.v: PASS: p and every wall survivor have list {2,3,4}; n0,a1,a2,r have list {1,3,4}; m,w,Z_n have list [4].

structural_checks: P and N lie in the required Y(type) sets.
M={m} lies in Y0 and is complete to P union N.
All three sets have size one, so Z(T,T')=Z(T',T)=empty by the source definition.
admissibility_checks: p,n0 colors lie in [4]\({1} union {2})={3,4} in both ordered states.
f union f_Q is proper on S union S(Q): s1-s2-n0-m-p-s1 is properly colored 1-2-4-2-3-1.

post_Q_state.lemma10: Identity after canonical repartition; there are no size-1/2 vertices and G remains connected.

normal_subcase: Add only a1,a2 to the seed.
w is hit by the new seed and leaves residual Y0 before Lemma10.
No z_e is adjacent to a1 or a2, so residual Y0 is exactly Z_n.
seed_two_replay.VI_failure: PASS: every wall vertex has a residual-Y0 neighbor and list L', while r has residual-Y0 neighbor z* and list L0; therefore at least two exact 3-list classes meet residual Y0.

coordinates.old_source_type: {s1}; every wall survivor is nonadjacent to s2,p,m,n0
coordinates.selected_witness_mask: J={2}; c2=3 is in L' and every wall survivor is nonadjacent to a2; c1=1 is not in L'

one_coarse_class_sigma.source_Z: Every wall survivor belongs to the original source Z(L') because a2 is its nonneighbor and g(a2)=3 belongs to L'.

component_incidence.residual_Y0: Z_n is stable, so every component is singleton {z_e}.
component_incidence.incidence: For v in S_sigma and C={z_e}, v is complete to C iff v is an endpoint of wall edge e.
component_incidence.conclusion: I_sigma is exactly J_n, the graph obtained from W_n by 1-subdividing every wall edge.

P7_free_theorem.name: SUBDIVIDED_WALL_SOURCE_FAMILY_P7_FREE_V1
step1_Z_simplicial: For ordinary z_e, N(z_e)={a,b} with a in A_n,b in B_n, and ab is an edge because A_n is complete to B_n.
For special z*, N(z*)={a*,b*,r}; these three vertices are pairwise adjacent because A-B is complete and r is complete to all wall survivors.
Thus every z_e is simplicial. A simplicial vertex cannot be an internal vertex of an induced path with at least three vertices, so Z_n vertices can occur only as path endpoints.

step2_false_twin_reduction.lemma: An induced path on at least four vertices contains at most one vertex from any independent false-twin class.
step2_false_twin_reduction.proof: If false twins u,v occur at path-distance >=3, the neighbor of u toward v is also adjacent to v, a chord. If their distance is 2, then in a path with at least four vertices one of u,v has a second path-neighbor, which is also adjacent to the other twin, again a chord.
step2_false_twin_reduction.consequence: Every induced P5/P6/P7 in R=G-Z_n maps injectively to the fixed 10-role graph.

finite_certificate.induced_P6_endpoint_property: Every P6 endpoint lies outside D={A,B,r}.
finite_certificate.induced_P5_endpoint_property: No induced P5 has both endpoints in D={A,B,r}.

final_case_split: If a hypothetical induced P7 contains no Z vertex, it is an induced P7 of R, impossible by the role certificate.
If it contains exactly one Z endpoint, deleting it leaves an induced P6 of R whose adjacent endpoint lies in D=N(Z); no P6 of R has an endpoint in D.
If it contains two Z endpoints, deleting them leaves an induced P5 of R with both endpoints in D; no such P5 exists.

external_theorems: Theorem 8, IPEC 2020: mimw(W_n)>=sqrt(n)/50 for elementary (n x n)-walls, n>=7.
Lemma 2, IPEC 2020: 1-subdividing an edge does not decrease mim-width.
mim_width.derivation: Apply Lemma 2 sequentially to every wall edge. Since I_sigma=J_n is the all-edge 1-subdivision, mimw(I_sigma)>=mimw(W_n)>=sqrt(n)/50.

gate_verdict.reason: A fixed-seed, fixed-coarse-signature, P7-free, exact Q/Lemma10/seed-two source family exists whose union-incidence graph has mim-width growing at least sqrt(n)/50.

consequences: B1A per-layer P7-freeness, full-quotient P7-freeness, fixed coarse signature, and exact source ancestry do not force bounded mim-width of I_sigma.
No universal B1B1A theorem of the form 'every B0 coarse class has seed-bounded common-layer mim-width' can hold.
Conditional D1 counting remains correct but cannot be made universal by proving a seed-bounded common mim layout for every coarse class.

Future positive repair must either route this wall family through a different already-sealed source mechanism, exploit additional restrictions not shared by this family, or abandon common-mim as the universal composition mechanism.
